payload.description: Components recall is 3/519 (0.6%). Two root causes: (1) scanner under-detects components (2 for pocketbase vs 7 gold); (2) identity-key mismatch — scanner uses type:name (per-instance, e.g. asset:pocketbase-database), gold uses type:subtype (per-class, e.g. asset:database). Even detected components don't score. Gold is mostly asset:database (181), asset:api (118), asset:auth_service (109). Fix the classifier to detect these classes and fix the identity key to subtype-based (or normalize in scoring). This unblocks the flow slice (40+ route flows need detected components for endpoints). Do not change gold. Measure against pinned baseline; recall up, precision not cratered.
payload.title: Detect component classes (database/api/auth_service) with subtype identity
